name: MedFund call for beneficiaries: Mediterranean MPA management
summary: Grants to management and co-management structures of Mediterranean marine protected areas to cover recurrent management costs such as surveillance, monitoring, staff and small equipment, in ten priority countries.

geography.label: Priority intervention countries in the Mediterranean

status.quote: The Call for Expressions of Interest is now closed.

deadline.quote: Phase 2: Preparation and submission of the application, by 2nd October 2026 (midnight CEST)

applicant_types.quote: Any application submitted by a non-governmental organization must be accompanied by a letter of approval or support from the national authorities responsible for marine protected areas.

geography.quote: Priority intervention countries are as follows: Albania, Algeria, Croatia, Egypt, Greece, Lebanon, Morocco, Montenegro, Tunisia and Türkiye.

access.quote: The MedFund provides technical and financial support through grants to management and co-management structures of Mediterranean MPAs

window.quote: This call for expressions of interest is organized in two phases: Phase 1: Expression of interest, until 31st of July 2026
